textEn: Honestly I still have about a third of the bottle left. I only wash my hair twice a week.
textOriginal: Honestly I still have about a third of the bottle left. I only wash my hair twice a week.

textEn: The same bottle is still going; it hasn't run out yet.
textOriginal: अभी भी वही बोतल चल रही है, ख़त्म ही नहीं हुई।

textEn: The old bottle isn't finished yet. I'll buy again when it is.
textOriginal: ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಳೆಯ ಬಾಟಲ್ ಮುಗಿದಿಲ್ಲ. ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ತಗೋತೀನಿ.

textEn: Liked the first bottle but is not sure they would buy it again.
Checked the bottle label during the call before answering how often they use the shampoo.
After it dried my hair felt a bit sticky and heavy.
textOriginal: ಒಣಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೂದಲು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಅಂಟು ಅಂಟಾಗಿ, ಭಾರ ಅನ್ನಿಸ್ತು.

textEn: Felt the lather was thinner than their usual brand.
The first order came three days late and the cap had cracked.
textOriginal: The first order came three days late and the cap had cracked.

textEn: Price was fine. About what I pay for any decent shampoo.
textOriginal: Price was fine. About what I pay for any decent shampoo.

textEn: Did not raise price unprompted; when asked, said the cost was okay.
Said price was not a factor in not reordering.
I'd buy again if it came on time. The price isn't the issue.
textOriginal: समय पर आए तो फिर से लूँगी, दाम की कोई दिक्कत नहीं है।
